key_impacts: COVID-19 cases detected in Malaysia including the first domestic case
Cases escalated leading to a more serious situation locally
Nationwide Movement Control Order implemented in phases (March–May 2020)
Major events in Malaysia, including the 2020 APSTCDRR conference, were cancelled due to COVID-19
evidence_snippets: The first case of COVID-19 was reported in Malaysia on 14 January 2020
The first domestic case was reported on 5 February 2020; since then, cases have escalated
The Government of Malaysia imposed the Movement Control Order … 18–31 March … extended … as a recovery phase … 29 April until 12 May 2020
